card_en: With exactly two, a noun takes the dual: dva brata, dve sestri. With three or four, the plural: trije bratje, tri sestre. The two of them is onadva, with sta: onadva sta brata.

example.en: The two of them are brothers.

m.pl.note_en: With three or four: trije bratje.

quick_check.explain_en: With exactly two, the noun takes the dual: dva otroka, two children.

helper_de: German goes from one to many: ein Bruder, zwei Brüder. Slovenian has its own form for exactly two: dva brata.
helper_en: English has singular and plural only. Slovenian keeps a third number for pairs: brat, brata, bratje.
